title: 15 AI Safety Philosophy
summary: Specifies the decentralized, node-local AI safety enforcement model for GeniusCognitiveSystem across four layers: node screening, reputation penalties, client preference filtering, and tool intermediary control.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity resolved toward SPEC: prose-heavy 'Philosophy' framing and no frontmatter or filename convention, but content defines normative technical contracts (NodeCapabilities data model, versioned signed safety profiles distributed via IPFS, reputation penalty formula, swarm-mode safety sequence, explicit no-GeoIP constraints).
